hook.name: StandardV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/token pool that charges a volatility-scaled fee (1–7%, based on previous-swap tick movement) on every exact-input buy and sell. Fees are routed to a CentralBankController, and net ETH flow per epoch is tracked to drive expansion or contraction of a reserve-backed token system. Pool initialization is restricted to the bound controller.
